weathers.name: cold clarity
weathers.note: winter light, precision, attention. the feeling of a room where the dust is visible.

weathers.name: dissolution
weathers.note: edges going. fog, late light, the moment a shape stops being a shape.

weathers.name: invincible summer
weathers.note: heat held against the dark. not optimism: the thing that survives the winter.

weathers.name: nerve
weathers.note: ambition with its nerve showing. daring, and the cost of daring, and doing it anyway.

weathers.name: the dark and the lamp
weathers.note: night, solitude, one light on. company at a distance.

weathers.name: the plain thing
weathers.note: one object, looked at properly, until it stops being ordinary.

weathers.name: vastness
weathers.note: the scale that puts you in your place, and the relief in that.

weathers.name: weight and grace
weathers.note: gravity, falling, and being held anyway.
